apple_parse: en_US posting with HTML in description and locations
args: JSON.parse("{\"loaderData\":{\"jobDetails\":{\"jobsData\":{\"localizations\":{\"en_US\":{\"postingTitle\":\"Software Engineer\",\"jobSummary\":\"Build great products\",\"description\":\"Write code\",\"minimumQualifications\":\"BS in CS\",\"preferredQualifications\":\"MS in CS\"}},\"locations\":[{\"name\":\"Cupertino\",\"countryName\":\"United States\"}]}}}}")

expect.title: Software Engineer
expect.text:
Build great products
Write code
BS in CS
MS in CS

why: The spec says text = 'those four joined' without naming a separator, and loc = names 'with their countryName' without naming the joining punctuation; newline and 'name, countryName' are assumed.
